sketches.mechanism: An empty data type has no constructors, and with EmptyCase a case expression over it is exhaustive with no branches, allowing a function from impossibility to any type.
sketches.resonance: What cannot arrive can nevertheless be made to imply everything, because absence has no counterexample.

sketches.mechanism: Nothing? is inhabited only by null, and the non-null assertion operator !! turns a denied null into an immediate runtime exception.
sketches.resonance: Insisting on presence where only absence can live makes the program break at the point of denial.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever; in the sole goroutine the runtime can only discover deadlock.
sketches.resonance: A listener waiting on a channel connected to no one becomes permanent waiting.
